meta.name: PQ Doge Wallet
meta.shortDescription: The first Post Quantum Secure Dogecoin wallet
meta.longDescription: Built with libdogecoin (+ liboqs): `such` (P2PKH keys, Falcon-512 keygen, sign, commitments), `sendtx` (P2P broadcast), and `spvnode` (headers + BIP37 address watch). **Pending** incoming DOGE uses an embedded MemeTracker-compatible P2P mempool watcher (storage under `mempooltracker/`); no separate MemeTracker pup is required.

sections.name: HTTP
sections.description: Web UI and JSON API bind address is 0.0.0.0 inside the container.

sections.name: Chain & SPV
sections.description: libdogecoin `spvnode` syncs headers and watches your primary address. Log tail parsing drives chain tip and peer hints in the dashboard.

fields.name: SPVNODE_ENABLE
fields.label: Start spvnode after wallet is created (1=yes, 0=no)

sections.name: Explorer (optional)
sections.description: Block explorer helpers for balance and transaction lookups.

fields.name: EXPLORER_TX_API
fields.label: Explorer tx API URL with {txid} placeholder (empty = disabled)

fields.name: EXPLORER_ADDRESS_API
fields.label: Explorer address API URL with {address} (e.g. Blockchair dashboards/address/{address})

sections.name: Mempool watcher (embedded)
sections.description: Optional tuning for the in-process P2P mempool relay watcher (same semantics as MemeTracker `MTR_*` env). Data lives under `PQ_STORAGE_DIR/mempooltracker/`.

fields.name: MTR_LIST_LIMIT
fields.label: Stored mempool tx rows per address (empty = default)
